meaning.en: Fan stalled; fan fault.
meaning.ur: Pankha ruka hawa fan kharabi.

causes.en: Fan fault.
causes.ur: Pankha kharab

causes.en: Fan connector loose or fan supply wire broken.
causes.ur: Fan ka connection dheela hai ya supply wire tooti hui hai.

causes.en: Main board fan driver circuit failed.
causes.ur: Main board ka fan driver circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC input and PV, open the DC breaker and wait 5 minutes; then open the cover and look for dust, wires or a foreign object blocking the fan blades.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC input aur PV band karein, DC breaker kholein aur 5 minute intezar karein; phir cover khol kar dekhein ke pankha ki blades par dhool, taar ya koi cheez atki hui hai.

solutions.en: With power isolated, spin the fan by hand — it must turn freely; check the fan plug is seated on the board and has no burn marks.
solutions.ur: Power band hone ke baad pankha haath se ghuma kar dekhein — ise azaadi se ghumna chahiye; fan ka plug board par theek laga hai aur us par jale hue nishan to nahin, yeh check karein.

solutions.en: If the fan is stuck or does not run after restart, replace it with the same size fan and retest the unit.
solutions.ur: Agar pankha atka hua hai ya restart ke baad bhi nahin chalta, to usi size ka naya fan lagayein aur unit ko dobara test karein.

meaning.en: Internal over-temperature trip.
meaning.ur: Andaruni over-temperature trip.

causes.en: Internal temperature of inverter component is over 100°C.
causes.ur: Inverter ka temperature 100°C se zyada

causes.en: Temperature of internal converter component is over 120°C.
causes.ur: Converter ka temperature 120°C se zyada

solutions.en: Turn off AC input and PV, let the unit cool for 10–15 minutes, and clear anything blocking the vents; clean dust from the filters and heat sinks.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV band kar ke unit ko 10-15 minute thanda hone dein, vent ke saamne jo rukawat hai hata dein; filters aur heat sinks se dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: After cooling, restart the unit with a lighter load and listen that the cooling fan runs; also check the room ambient is not too hot.
solutions.ur: Thanda hone par kam load ke sath unit restart karein aur sun kar maaloom karein ke pankha chal raha hai; kamre ka temperature bhi check karein ke woh bohat zyada to nahin.

solutions.en: If the trip comes back with clear airflow, the temperature sensor or fan is faulty — have the board checked at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar hawa ka rasta saaf hone ke baad bhi trip wapas aa jaye, to temperature sensor ya pankha kharab hai — board ko service centre se check karwayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon on; red LED solid; buzzer beeps continuously.

meaning.en: Battery voltage below operating threshold; unit trips.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage operating had se neeche; unit trip ho jata hai.

causes.en: The battery voltage is too low (<1.91V/Cell).
causes.ur: voltage bohat kam (<1.91V/cell)

causes.en: Battery voltage far too low (<1.4V/Cell) or polarity reversed / fuse tripped.
causes.ur: Voltage bahat kam (<1.4V/Cell), polarity ulti ho gayi ya fuse trip ho gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV first, then measure the battery pack voltage with a multimeter; charge the battery before any further testing.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC input aur PV alag karein, phir multimeter se battery pack ka voltage naapein; aur testing se pehle battery ko charge kar lein.

solutions.en: Check battery polarity, terminals and the main fuse with power isolated; a reversed connection or blown fuse must be fixed first.
solutions.ur: Power band kar ke battery ki polarity, terminals aur main fuse check karein; ulti connection ya uda hua fuse pehle theek karna zaroori hai.

solutions.en: Load-test the battery — if voltage collapses under load or a cell is dead, recharge or replace the battery and restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Battery ka load-test karein — load par voltage gir jaye ya koi cell khaali ho to battery charge ya replace kar ke unit dobara start karein.

meaning.en: Output short circuit detected.
meaning.ur: Output short circuit ho gaya.

causes.en: Output short circuited.
causes.ur: output short circuit

causes.en: Damaged appliance or tool causing the short on the output.
causes.ur: Koi kharab appliance ya tool output par short bana raha hai.

causes.en: Moisture or loose joint in the output wiring.
causes.ur: Output wiring mein pani (moisture) ya dheela joint hai.

solutions.en: Stop the unit and isolate AC input and PV immediately — never probe a suspected short while the output is live.
solutions.ur: Unit rok dein aur foran AC input aur PV alag karein — output chalte hue suspected short par kabhi probe na karein.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output wiring and each appliance for short marks, burning or wet joints; unplug the suspect load.
solutions.ur: Supply band kar ke output wiring aur har appliance check karein ke short ke nishan, jalan ya geele joints to nahin; shak wala load plug se nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Remove the shorted load or repair the wiring, then restart; if the code returns, the output stage needs service.
solutions.ur: Short load hatayein ya wiring theek karein, phir restart karein; code wapas aaye to output stage ki service zaroori hai.

meaning.en: AC output voltage outside acceptable band.
meaning.ur: AC output voltage qubool had ke bahar.

causes.en: Output abnormal (inverter voltage below 190Vac or higher than 260Vac).
causes.ur: output ghair mamooli (190Vac se kam ya 260Vac se zyada)

causes.en: Heavy load drags the output voltage outside the band.
causes.ur: Bhari load ki wajah se output voltage band se bahar chala jata hai.

causes.en: Output stage / AVR component on the main board failed.
causes.ur: Main board ka output stage ya AVR component kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: First switch off heavy loads and non-essential equipment so the inverter runs light, then measure the AC output with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle bhari load aur zaroori na honay wale appliances band kar dein taake inverter halke load par chale, phir multimeter se AC output naapein.

solutions.en: With the unit isolated from mains, check the output wiring and terminal connections for looseness or burn marks.
solutions.ur: Unit ko mains se alag kar ke output wiring aur terminal connections check karein ke kahin dheela ya jale hue nishan to nahin.

solutions.en: If the output is still outside the limit with a light load, stop and return the unit to the repair centre — the output stage needs service.
solutions.ur: Agar halke load par bhi output phir bhi limit se bahar rahe, to unit ko repair centre le jayein — output stage ki service zaroori hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon on; red LED solid; buzzer beeps continuously.

meaning.en: More than 110% load until time is up; output cut.
meaning.ur: 110% se zyada load par waqt khatam; output band.

causes.en: The inverter is overloaded 110% and time is up.
causes.ur: Inverter 110% se zyada load par tha aur waqt khatam ho gaya.

causes.en: Too many appliances started together at the same time.
causes.ur: Ek sath bohat sare appliances start ho gaye.

causes.en: Motor or pump drawing more than its rated current.
causes.ur: Motor ya pump apne rated current se zyada kha raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off non-essential equipment so the load drops below the inverter rating, then restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Zaroori na honay wale appliances band kar dein taake load inverter rating se neeche aa jaye, phir unit restart karein.

solutions.en: Check the load with a clamp meter if available — motors and pumps can draw more than their nameplate current.
solutions.ur: Agar clamp meter ho to load check karein — motors aur pumps nameplate current se zyada kha sakte hain.

solutions.en: Restart only after the load is reduced; if it trips again, split the load across the day or have the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Load kam hone ke baad hi restart karein; phir trip ho to load aadhe aadhe kar ke baant dein ya unit check karwayein.

meaning.en: Internal DC bus over-voltage trip.
meaning.ur: Andaruni DC bus par over-voltage trip.

causes.en: Internal components failed.
causes.ur: Andaruni components kharab

causes.en: Load dump or regenerative energy pushed the DC bus above the limit.
causes.ur: Load dump ya regenerative energy ne DC bus ko limit se upar kar diya.

causes.en: DC bus capacitor or bleed resistor failed.
causes.ur: DC bus capacitor ya bleed resistor kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power off, switch off AC input and PV and wait 5 minutes; do not probe the DC bus — dangerous voltage stays stored in the capacitors.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, AC input aur PV off kar ke 5 minute intezar karein; DC bus par probe na rakhein — capacitors mein khatarnak voltage reh jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the cover only with supply isolated and look for burnt parts, bulged capacitors or loose connections; do not power it up again.
solutions.ur: Sirf supply band hone par cover kholein aur jalay hue parts, phoolay hue capacitors ya dheele connections dekhein; dobara power na dein.

solutions.en: If the fault repeats after a restart, the bus or soft-start components have failed — send the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Agar restart ke baad bhi fault aa jaye, to bus ya soft-start components kharab ho chuke hain — unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

meaning.en: Bus soft-start failure.
meaning.ur: Bus soft start nakaam.

causes.en: Internal components failed.
causes.ur: Andaruni components kharab

causes.en: DC bus capacitors did not charge evenly during soft-start.
causes.ur: Soft-start ke dauran DC bus capacitors barabar charge nahin hue.

causes.en: Soft-start relay or resistor circuit fault.
causes.ur: Soft-start relay ya resistor circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, wait 5 minutes, then restart once and watch whether the bus comes up or the code returns immediately.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute ruk kar ek baar restart karein aur dekhein ke bus upar aata hai ya code foran wapas aa jata hai.

solutions.en: Check the DC input wiring and main fuse for looseness or damage; do not probe the high-voltage bus yourself.
solutions.ur: DC input wiring aur main fuse check karein ke dheela ya kharab to nahin; high-voltage bus par khud probe na karein.

solutions.en: Since the bus soft-start stage has failed, send the unit to the repair centre for board-level repair.
solutions.ur: Kyunki bus soft-start stage kharab hai, unit ko board-level repair ke liye repair centre bhej dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon on; red LED solid; buzzer beeps continuously.

meaning.en: PV input voltage above limit (>450V per troubleshooting).
meaning.ur: PV input voltage had se zyada (troubleshooting ke mutabiq >450V).

causes.en: Solar input voltage is more than 450V.
causes.ur: solar input voltage 450V se zyada

causes.en: Too many modules in series for the array design.
causes.ur: Array design ke liye series mein modules zyada hain.

causes.en: Cold weather raised Voc above the limit.
causes.ur: Sardi mein Voc limit se upar chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the PV DC isolator, then measure the array open-circuit voltage with a meter and confirm it is not above the 450V stated in troubleshooting.
solutions.ur: PV DC isolator band karein, phir meter se array ka open-circuit voltage naapein aur confirm karein ke woh troubleshooting mein diye 450V se upar to nahin.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of PV modules in series so the voltage stays within the limit, then reconnect and restart.
solutions.ur: Voltage limit ke andar rahe ke liye series mein PV modules ki tadad kam kar ke dobara connect kar ke restart karein.

solutions.en: Check panels for damage and DC connectors for burning or water; replace what is faulty before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Panels mein kharabi aur DC connectors mein jalan ya paani check karein; dobara power se pehle jo kharab ho use badal dein.

causes.en: Current sensor (CT/shunt) disconnected or damaged.
causes.ur: Current sensor (CT/shunt) disconnect ho gaya ya kharab hai.

causes.en: Main board sensing circuit fault.
causes.ur: Main board ki sensing circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, wait 5 minutes, then restart once to see whether the code clears.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute ruk kar ek baar restart karein aur dekhein ke code hat jata hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: Open the unit with power isolated and check that the current sensor (CT/shunt) connector is seated and undamaged.
solutions.ur: Power band kar ke unit kholein aur check karein ke current sensor (CT/shunt) ka connector theek laga hai ya kharab to nahin.

solutions.en: The sensor or its board circuit has failed — send the unit to the repair centre for replacement.
solutions.ur: Sensor ya us ka board circuit kharab ho gaya hai — unit ko replacement ke liye repair centre bhej dein.

meaning.en: AC output voltage low/abnormal.
meaning.ur: AC output voltage kam/ghair mamooli

causes.en: Output abnormal (below 190Vac or above 260Vac).
causes.ur: output ghair mamooli (190Vac se kam ya 260Vac se zyada)

causes.en: Heavy load or long output cable causing voltage drop.
causes.ur: Bhari load ya lambi output cable ki wajah se voltage drop ho raha hai.

causes.en: Weak battery or failing output stage.
causes.ur: Battery kamzor hai ya output stage kharab ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load and restart; measure the AC output with a multimeter to see whether it stays below the limit.
solutions.ur: Load kam kar ke restart karein; multimeter se AC output naapein ke woh limit se neeche rahta hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: Check the battery voltage under load and the output wiring for loose joints — both drag the output down.
solutions.ur: Load par battery voltage aur output wiring ke dheele joints check karein — dono output ko neeche kheenchte hain.

solutions.en: If the voltage is still low after these steps, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: In steps ke baad bhi voltage kam rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Icon flashing; relay cycling on/off at startup; no beep documented.

meaning.en: Parallel power feedback detected; inverter shuts down and shows code 60.
meaning.ur: Parallel power feedback detect hua; inverter band ho kar code 60 dikhata hai.

causes.en: Parallel operation — power feedback into the inverter (wiring/phasing or grid-tie backfeed condition).
causes.ur: Parallel operation — inverter mein wapas aata power (wiring/phasing ya grid-tie backfeed ki haalat).

causes.en: L/N reversed between the paralleled units.
causes.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan L/N ulta laga hua hai.

causes.en: Current-sharing cable missing or wrong type.
causes.ur: Current-sharing cable missing hai ya ghalat type ki hai.

solutions.en: Shut down all paralleled units and isolate AC input and PV — power feedback between units is dangerous until the wiring is corrected.
solutions.ur: Tamam parallel units band kar ke AC input aur PV alag karein — wiring theek hone tak units ke darmiyan power feedback khatarnak hai.

solutions.en: Check the parallel wiring and L/N phasing between units with a meter, and confirm the current-sharing cables are fitted correctly.
solutions.ur: Meter se units ke darmiyan parallel wiring aur L/N phasing check karein, aur confirm karein ke current-sharing cables theek lagi hain.

solutions.en: Do not re-energise until the installer has verified the wiring; contact your installer if the code remains.
solutions.ur: Installer ke wiring verify karne tak dobara power na dein; code bana rahe to installer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Firmware versions across parallel units differ → shutdown + code 71.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke firmware versions alag alag hain → unit off + code 71.

causes.en: Different firmware versions installed in the parallel system.
causes.ur: Parallel system mein alag-alag firmware versions lage hue hain.

causes.en: One unit was upgraded while the others stayed on the old package.
causes.ur: Ek unit upgrade ho gayi, baqi purane package par reh gayin.

causes.en: Replacement board fitted with newer firmware.
causes.ur: Nayi board lagayi gayi jisme firmware zyada naya hai.

solutions.en: Note the firmware/CPU version shown on each unit and compare them — all paralleled units must run the same version.
solutions.ur: Har unit par dikhai firmware/CPU version note kar ke compare karein — sab parallel units par wohi version hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Do not keep running the system with mixed versions; contact your installer for the correct firmware package.
solutions.ur: Alag alag versions ke sath system chalate na rahein; sahi firmware package ke liye installer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Upgrade all units to the same version and restart the parallel system to confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Tamam units ko ek hi version par upgrade kar ke parallel system restart karein aur confirm karein ke code hat gaya.

meaning.en: Unequal current sharing between parallel units → shutdown + code 72.
meaning.ur: Parallel units mein current barabar nahi banta → off + code 72

causes.en: Current sharing out of balance in parallel operation.
causes.ur: Parallel operation mein current sharing balance ke bahar hai.

causes.en: Output N wires not commoned between units.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan output N wires common nahin hain.

causes.en: Unequal cable length or loose sharing connection.
causes.ur: Cable ki lambai alag alag hai ya sharing connection dheela hai.

solutions.en: Shut down the paralleled units and isolate supplies before checking any parallel wiring.
solutions.ur: Parallel wiring check se pehle tamam units band kar ke supplies alag karein.

solutions.en: Check that the output N wires are commoned and the current-sharing cables are tight, equal in length and the right type.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke output N wires common hain aur current-sharing cables tight, lambai mein barabar aur sahi type ki hain.

solutions.en: Balance the load across the units, restart, and if the code remains contact your installer.
solutions.ur: Units mein load barabar baant kar restart karein, aur code bana rahe to installer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: AC output configuration differs across parallel units → shutdown + code 73.
meaning.ur: parallel units ki AC output setting alag → off + code 73

causes.en: Different AC output settings between units.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan AC output settings alag hain.

causes.en: Voltage/frequency set points changed on one unit only.
causes.ur: Sirf ek unit par voltage/frequency set points badal diye gaye.

causes.en: Output mode or ECO setting mismatch between units.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan output mode ya ECO setting mein farq hai.

solutions.en: Power down the paralleled units and note the AC output settings (voltage, frequency, mode) shown in each unit's menu.
solutions.ur: Parallel units band kar ke har unit ke menu mein AC output settings (voltage, frequency, mode) note karein.

solutions.en: Compare the settings and set every unit to the same values; a mismatch here causes the shutdown with code 73.
solutions.ur: Settings compare kar ke har unit par wohi values set karein; yahan farq hone par code 73 ke sath shutdown ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If the settings already match or the code returns after aligning them, contact your installer or the service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar settings pehle se barabar hain ya align karne ke baad code wapas aaye, to installer ya service centre se rabta karein.

meaning.en: CAN bus communication fault between parallel units.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke CAN bus ka rabta kharab hai.

causes.en: CAN wiring/connection fault.
causes.ur: CAN wiring/connection kharab

causes.en: CAN cable disconnected or connector pin damaged.
causes.ur: CAN cable nikli hui hai ya connector pin tooti hui hai.

causes.en: Communication port on one unit is faulty.
causes.ur: Ek unit ka communication port kharab hai.

solutions.en: Power down the units and isolate AC input before touching the communication wiring.
solutions.ur: Communication wiring chhoone se pehle units band kar ke AC input alag karein.

solutions.en: Check the CAN cable at both ends — it must be fully plugged in with no broken pins or cuts in the cable.
solutions.ur: CAN cable dono ends par check karein — pura plug lagna chahiye, pin tooti ya cable katna nahi chahiye.

solutions.en: Swap the cable with a known-good one and restart; if the code remains, contact your installer.
solutions.ur: Cable ko kisi known-good cable se badal kar restart karein; phir bhi code bana rahe to installer se rabta karein.

meaning.ur: Units ke darmiyan AC phase synchronization toot gayi.

causes.en: Synchronization between inverters lost (wiring, grid, or unit fault).
causes.ur: Inverters ke darmiyan synchronization toot gayi (wiring, grid ya unit fault).

causes.en: AC input breakers switched on at different times.
causes.ur: AC input breakers alag alag waqt par on kiye gaye.

causes.en: Grid phase or frequency shifted while running.
causes.ur: Chalte waqt grid phase ya frequency badal gaya.

solutions.en: Shut down the units and isolate AC input before checking the parallel setup.
solutions.ur: Parallel setup check se pehle units band kar ke AC input alag karein.

solutions.en: Turn on the AC input breakers of all units at the same time and check the mains wiring and phasing between them.
solutions.ur: Tamam units ke AC input breakers ek sath on karein aur un ke darmiyan mains wiring aur phasing check karein.

solutions.en: If the units still lose sync after a simultaneous start, contact your installer — the grid or one unit may be faulty.
solutions.ur: Ek sath start karne ke baad bhi units ka sync toota rahe, to installer se rabta karein — grid ya koi unit kharab ho sakti hai.

meaning.ur: parallel units ki battery voltages had se alag hain

causes.en: Battery wiring/SoC mismatch between units.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan battery wiring/SoC mein farq hai.

causes.en: Different battery strings or uneven charge level.
causes.ur: Alag alag battery strings hain ya charge level barabar nahin.

causes.en: Long or thin battery cables causing voltage drop.
causes.ur: Lambi ya patli battery cables ki wajah se voltage drop ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate supplies, then measure the battery voltage at each unit's DC input with the same meter.
solutions.ur: Supplies alag kar ke ek hi meter se har unit ke DC input par battery voltage naapein.

solutions.en: Check that all units share one battery bank and that cable length and size are equal; fix loose or thin cables.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sab units ek hi battery bank use karte hain aur cable ki lambai aur size barabar hai; dheeli ya patli cables theek karein.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the readings match; if they still differ, contact your installer.
solutions.ur: Restart kar ke confirm karein ke readings barabar hain; phir bhi farq rahe to installer se rabta karein.

causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan AC input sensing / mains ki haalat alag hai.

causes.en: Loose AC input connection on one unit.
causes.ur: Ek unit par AC input connection dheela hai.

causes.en: One unit connected on a different mains phase.
causes.ur: Ek unit dusre mains phase par lagi hui hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input, then check the mains wiring to each unit for loose terminals or a different phase.
solutions.ur: AC input alag kar ke har unit ki mains wiring check karein ke terminals dheele ya phase alag to nahin.

solutions.en: Measure the mains voltage at each unit's input with a meter and compare the readings.
solutions.ur: Meter se har unit ke input par mains voltage naapein aur readings compare karein.

solutions.en: Fix the wiring so all units see the same mains, restart, and contact your installer if the code remains.

meaning.en: AC output currents unbalanced across parallel units.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke AC output currents unbalanced hain.

causes.en: Unequal load distribution across phases/units.
causes.ur: Phases/units par load barabar baant nahi hua.

causes.en: Single-phase loads concentrated on one unit.
causes.ur: Sare single-phase load ek par lage hue hain.

causes.en: Unequal AC output cable length between units.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan AC output cable ki lambai alag alag hai.

solutions.en: Isolate supplies and check how the load is distributed across units and phases.
solutions.ur: Supplies alag kar ke dekhein ke load units aur phases mein kaise banta hua hai.

solutions.en: Move some loads so each unit carries a similar share, and check the AC output cables are equal in length and type.
solutions.ur: Kuch load hata kar har unit par thoda thoda load dein, aur AC output cables ki lambai aur type barabar check karein.

solutions.en: Restart and watch the output currents; if they stay unbalanced, contact your installer.
solutions.ur: Restart kar ke output currents dekhein; agar unbalanced bane rahein, to installer se rabta karein.

title.en: AC output mode setting is different
title.ur: AC output mode setting alag hai.

meaning.en: AC output mode (e.g. normal/ECO or parallel mode) differs across units → shutdown + code 86.
meaning.ur: units ki AC output mode alag → off + code 86

causes.en: Different AC output mode settings between units.
causes.ur: units par alag output mode setting

causes.en: One unit left in a different ECO/normal output mode.
causes.ur: Ek unit alag ECO/normal output mode mein chhodi gayi hai.

causes.en: Parallel mode program set differently after service.
causes.ur: Service ke baad parallel mode program alag alag set ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power off the units and open the AC output mode menu on each unit.
solutions.ur: Units band kar ke har unit ka AC output mode menu kholein.

solutions.en: Compare the program/mode settings and set every unit to the same output mode (normal/ECO or parallel mode).
solutions.ur: Program/mode settings compare kar ke har unit ko ek hi output mode (normal/ECO ya parallel mode) par set karein.

solutions.en: Power up together and confirm the code clears; if it returns, contact your installer.
solutions.ur: Ek sath power on kar ke confirm karein ke code hat gaya; wapas aaye to installer se rabta karein.
